content: Don't try to understand life. Live it! Don't try to understand love. Move into love!
author: Osho
sourceWork: Awareness: The Key to Living in Balance
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

Across his life and work, Osho saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
